notes: Both occurrences of the supplied object it are marked added under rule 44; they stand in different clauses, so they are two units rather than one discontinuous one.
No object marker or suffix stands anywhere in this verse, so neither it can be folded into its verb's rendering.
bəyôm + infinitive is divided as in v5: in on the preposition, the day on the construct noun, that ... heareth on the infinitive, he on its suffix.
